entries.label: Alchemic
cells: Turns all friendly attacks into Cursed Skulls.

entries.label: Amplifier
cells: Summons a spiral, which deals 100% Damage, and +50% more Damage for each attack that moves through it.

entries.label: Badumdum
cells: Permanently boost the Basic Attack speed of all Mobs. Only recharges when a Basic Attack hits.

entries.label: Boomer
cells: Throws a boomerang, which deals 60% Damage and has an 80% chance to bounce.

entries.label: Borger
cells: Shoots 2 basic attacks, but would much rather have shot 2 burgers into its mouth.

entries.label: Breeder
cells: Every 1 sec, heal whatever Mob you are holding down on for 10% HP. On PC, you just need you mouse over the Mob. On Phones, your finger must be on the Mob. This lasts 15 seconds.

entries.label: Converter
cells: For 15 seconds, all basic fist attacks have a 30% chance to turn into the weapon of that Mob's ability, but only if their ability is a weapon.

entries.label: Cursory
cells: Shoots a Cursed Skull, which deals 50% Damage, and makes all future attacks deal +5% more dmg.

entries.label: Defender
cells: Throws an Armored Shield, which gives 85% block chance to Mobs it passes over, and deals 50% Damage.

entries.label: Defstone
cells: Shoots multiple rocks based on the total number of blocks by your team. Rocks deal 250% Damage. Resets total number of blocks when activated.

entries.label: Eggshell
cells: For 10 seconds, every critical hit boosts the block chance of all Mobs by 1%.

entries.label: Fastidious
cells: Permanently gives all Mobs +1% Crit Chance, +5% Crit DMG, and +2% ability regen speed. After 20 stacks, additional stacks give less bonus.

entries.label: Fastihoop
cells: Shoots a gold hoop, which deals 50% Damage. Each bullet that passes through the hoop has a 30% chance to give a permanent +1 Fastidious buff.

entries.label: Fighter
cells: Throws a Rusty Sword, which deals 200% Damage.

entries.label: Flashy
cells: Duplicates all friendly attacks instantly, almost like magic!

entries.label: Fleeter
cells: Boosts ability recharge rate for all Mobs by +30% for 8 sec. Doesn't boost other Fleeter Mobs though.

entries.label: Heavyweight
cells: Shoots a giant fist that deals 300% Damage. The giant fist itself shoots a basic fist attack every 1 sec.

entries.label: Lazarus
cells: Fires a laser, dealing 100% Damage to all enemies every 1 sec. Strangely enough, the laser will continue zapping as long as you dont click anything.

entries.label: Looter
cells: Activates a random ability, selected from all the abilites across all Mobs you've ever unlocked.

entries.label: Mercenary
cells: Throws 2-3 small daggers which deal 150% Damage.

entries.label: Miasma
cells: Fully heal all Mobs. Also, for 60 sec all enemies have -100% crit chance and all Mobs have +20% block chance. Always starts 100% filled.

entries.label: Monolithic
cells: Freezes time for 6 seconds. During this, Mob continue to shoot Basic Attacks and regenerate abilities.

entries.label: Ninja
cells: Shoots 4 ninja stars, which deal 175% Damage each.

entries.label: Opticular
cells: Permanently boosts the Crit Chance of all Mobs. Only recharges when an attack Critical Hits.

entries.label: Peapeapod
cells: Shoot 10 tiny peas which deal 75% damage. Pow pow pow pow pow pow pow pow pow pow!!!

entries.label: Rattler
cells: Throws 5 bones. Bones deal 5% Damage, +1% more damage for each bone ever thrown.

entries.label: Refiller
cells: For 5 seconds, every non Basic Attack that hits a monster refills a random ability on the team by 5%.

entries.label: Shiny
cells: Thinks very happy thoughts. You can't see this of course, but trust me that lil' guy out there is happy!

entries.label: Sniper
cells: Fires a bullet at farthest enemy. 200% Damage, +30% Crit chance, 4x Crit DMG.

entries.label: Superboomer
cells: Throws 2 super boomerangs, which deal 100% Damage and has an 80% chance to bounce.

entries.label: Targeter
cells: The next non Basic Attack fired will deal x2.50 Damage.

entries.label: Trasher
cells: The next 6 taps delete any enemy attack you tap on. This ability will not refill while you have taps remaining.

pageProps.seoDescription: Every one of the 34 pet genes in Legends of Idleon, and what each one connects to.
